title: DQI: Measuring Data Quality in NLP
measurement_description: Identification and general consideration of religious stereotypes as a source of bias in Natural Language Inference (NLI) datasets. The paper's Data Quality Index (DQI) framework aims to help dataset creators produce datasets free of such unwanted biases, rather than directly measuring specific religious biases in its own evaluation.
findings: The paper identifies that NLI datasets can contain religious stereotypes (alongside gender, race, and age stereotypes) that lead models to exploit 'stereotype n-grams' as spurious biases, causing them to generalize poorly. The proposed Data Quality Index (DQI) framework is designed to help dataset creators reduce such biases and create harder benchmarks.
